lesson.name: Learn the Sicilian Sveshnikov
lesson.description: Learn the essentials of the Sicilian Sveshnikov with an educational video on move order, pawn structures and the key themes to know.

{How should White meet Black's aggressive e5 push?} 6. Ndb5 {[%wrong Black
will win material. Try to find a better move.] [%hint Save your knight and
target the vulnerable d6 square.]} (6. Nf5 $2 d5 {Black is doing well. Try to
find a better move.}) (6. Nf3 $2 Bb4 {Black is doing well. Try to find a
better move.}) (6. Nb3 $2 Bb4 {Black is doing well. Try to find a better move.}
) (6. Nde2 $2 Bb4 {Black is doing well. Try to find a better move.}) 6... a6 {
Good choice! In the Sveshnikov Black places a pawn on d6. If Black skips that
move, how can White reach a good position?} 7. Nd6+ {[%wrong Black wins
material. Try to find a better move.] [%hint Find a good check.]} (7. Na3 $2
Bxa3 {Black is slightly better. Try to find a stronger move.}) 7... Bxd6 {
Good move! What's next?} 8. Qxd6 {[%wrong Black is up material. Try again.] 
[%hint Recapture the piece.] Well played! White has the bishop pair and Black
has dark square weaknesses. That's why Black typically prevents Nd6.} *

{How should Black take advantage against White's mistaken Nf5 move?} 6... d5 {
[%wrong There's a stronger move. Try to find it.] [%hint Control the center
with pawns and undermine the defense of White's f5 knight.]} (6... d6 $2 7. Ne3
{White is slightly better and has strong control of d5. Try to find a stronger
move.}) (6... Bb4 $2 7. Nxg7+ {White wins material and exposes Black's king.
Try to find a better move.}) 7. exd5 {Good choice! What should you capture?}
Bxf5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it.] [%hint Capture the
unguarded knight.]} (7... Nxd5 $2 8. Nxg7+ {This desperado sacrifice gives
Black a good position. Try to find a stronger move.}) (7... Nb4 $2 8. Bb5+ {
White is better. Try to find a stronger move.}) 8. dxc6 {Good move! What
should you capture next?} Qxd1+ {[%wrong There's a better option. Try to find
it.] [%hint Trade into a good ending.]} (8... bxc6 $5 {This is reasonable, but
it's useful to make another capture first. What should you play?}) 9. Nxd1 {
Nice job! Where's the next capture?} bxc6 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try
to find it.] [%hint Equalize material.] Great play! Black has the more active
position in the ending.} *

{White's Nd5 is a currently popular option. What must Black play to avoid
losing material?} 7... Nxd5 {[%wrong White is winning. Try to find a stronger
move.] [%hint Capture one of the knights that threaten to fork on c7.]} (7...
Rb8 $2 8. Nbc7+ {White has a winning attack. Try to find a stronger move.}) (
7... Qa5+ $2 8. Bd2 {White will either win the queen or fork on c7 to win a
rook. Try to find a stronger move.}) 8. exd5 {Great start! How should you save
your knight?} Nb8 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it.] [%hint
Return your knight to it's starting square.] Well played! Both sides have
chances in this complicated position.} (8... Ne7 $5 {This is a good move. Try
to find the other strong option with your knight as well.}) (8... Nb4 $5 9. c3
{White is slightly better. Try to find a stronger move.}) (8... Na5 $2 9. b4 {
White wins the a5 knight. Try to find a stronger move.}) (8... a6 $2 9. dxc6 {
White will win material. Try to find a better move.}) *

{One downside for Black in the Sveshnikov is the weak d5 square. How can White
further weaken Black's control of this key square?} 7. Bg5 {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try to find it.] [%hint Pin the f6 knight.]} (7. Nd5 $5 {This is
a good move, although Black can safely trade on d5. How can White create a pin
to weaken Black's control of d5?}) 7... a6 {Good start! How should you save
your knight?} 8. Na3 {[%wrong Black wins material. Try to find a better move.]
[%hint Retreat the b5 knight to a safe square.]} (8. Bxf6 $5 {This is playable,
but there's no need to trade right away. How can you save your knight
immediately?}) 8... b5 {Great job! What's a good way to occupy the d5 outpost?}
9. Nd5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it.] [%hint Occupy the key
d5 square.] Well played! White's knight on d5 is a very powerful piece.} (9.
Bxf6 $5 {This is a good move, although it's not needed. How should you occupy
d5 right away?}) (9. Nab1 $2 Be7 {This move is safe, but passive. Black has a
comfortable position.}) (9. Qd5 $2 Nxd5 {Black wins material. Try again.}) *

{Black should have captured on f6 with a pawn instead of the queen. How should
White take advantage of the exposed queen?} 10. Nd5 {[%wrong There's a better
move. Try to find it.] [%hint Centralize your knight with a threat.]} Qd8 {
Good move! What strong sacrifice gives White a powerful attack?} 11. Bxb5 {
[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it and check the hint if you're
stuck.] [%hint Sacrifice a bishop to eliminate Black's queenside pawns and
allow more pieces into your attack.]} (11. c4 $5 {This is a good move, but
there's another strong option. Try to find it.}) (11. Nxb5 $2 axb5 {Black is
better. Try to find a stronger move.}) 11... axb5 {Good move! How can you
justify the piece sacrifice?} 12. Nxb5 {[%wrong Black is better. Try to find a
stronger move.] [%hint Capture a pawn and threaten a fork on c7.]} Qa5+ {
Good choice! How should you get out of check?} 13. c3 {[%wrong Black is better.
Try to find a stronger move.] [%hint Find a safe pawn move to block the check.
Black can't safely capture your b5 knight because of a fork.]} (13. Qd2 $2
Qxd2+ {Black is better. Try to find a stronger move.}) (13. b4 $2 Nxb4 {
Black is better. Try to find a stronger move.}) (13. Nbc3 $2 Ba6 {Black is
better. Try to find a stronger move.}) (13. Ndc3 $2 Ba6 {Black is better. Try
to find a stronger move.}) 13... Qxb5 {White had a strong attack anyway, but
Black's last move loses. How can White win Black's queen?} 14. Nc7+ {[%wrong
Black is winning. Try to find a better move.] [%hint Fork Black's king and
queen.]} Kd8 {Great move! What's next?} 15. Nxb5 {[%wrong Black is winning.
Try to find a better move.] [%hint Capture the black queen.] Great job!} *

{How should White create a path for the a3 knight to reach e3 and support the
other knight on d5?} 11. c3 {[%wrong There's a better option. Try to find it.]
[%hint Control the b4 square and clear a path for your a3 knight to reach the
e3 square.]} (11. g3 $5 {This is a good move but most players open a square
for the a3 knight to move toward the center. What do they play?}) (11. c4 $2 b4
{Black has a comfortable position. Try to find a stronger move.}) (11. Nxf6+ $2
Qxf6 {There's no hurry to trade the powerful d5 knight. Try to find a better
move.}) 11... Bb7 {Good start! How should White continue to improve the a3
knight?} 12. Nc2 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find a way to improve
the a3 knight.] [%hint Bring the a3 knight toward the useful e3 square.] 
Great work! The knight heads to e3 where it helps control the key d5 square.} (
12. g3 $5 {This is a good move, but it doesn't improve the a3 knight. How can
you do that?}) (12. Be2 $5 {This is a good move, but it doesn't improve the a3
knight. How can you do that?}) *
